narrative.text: You are taking a rare moment of peace on the Palace terrace, reading over dispatches. A mangy, starving stray dog wanders out of the garden bushes, looks at you, and collapses at your feet, panting heavily.
The groundskeeper called animal control, Chancellor. They will be here in ten minutes to... remove it. It's just a street dog. There are thousands of them in Ashenmere.

It's just a dog. A filthy, starving street dog. I have a nation to run, a border crisis to manage, and an election to win. I shouldn't care. But it looked at me like I was the only person in the world who could help it. It's just a dog. But it's alive, and it's suffering.

choices.text: Adopt the dog. Order the palace vet to treat it immediately.
Let animal control handle it. You don't have time for this.
Have Krel take it. A starving dog can be trained to bite intruders.
